newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Four held in Bahrain for arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Four held in Bahrain for arson attack.

text.p: Bahrain said on Sunday it had arrested four people who had carried out an arson attack last week in which an Asian worker was killed, Bahraini newspapers reported.
An Interior Ministry spokesman, quoted by the newspapers, said the four had confessed to the attack and would be tried before the State Security Court whose ruling cannot be challenged.
"Security forces will confront and deter any attempt by saboteurs to undermine safety or damage citizens' properties," the spokesman said.
An Asian worker received serious injuries and later died in hospital when the group torched two stores in Nuwaidrat village, 10 km (six miles) south of the capital Manama, on September 14.
